missions.title: TEN DARK MINUTES
missions.summary: The yard lamps cut out at 3am for ten minutes: get in, throw one up on the last carriage, shoot it and get clear.
intro: heard something. the yard lamps cut out at 3am. ten minutes, then they come back
patrol walks its loop the whole time. so it's quiet and it's quick
last carriage on the east side. one throw-up, one photo. then go

hint: walk. don't run. running is loud

objectives.text: PUT A THROW-UP ON THE LAST CARRIAGE
hint: fill it fast. the lamps won't stay off

objectives.text: GET CLEAR BEFORE THE PATROL COMES ROUND
hint: they're close. keep low and go

done: lamps are back on. you're not in them
